statement: A retryable authoritative node-read failure cannot masquerade as a missing node during priority recovery dispatch; it preserves typed unavailability so the existing bounded sync recovery-readiness fallback can advance the already-safe surplus REMOVE without weakening successful-empty or ineligible-node fail-closed behavior.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Before changing runtime source, reproduce through the real NodesOwner/SystemMetadataOwnerBase gateway contract that a retryable authoritative primary-key read failure becomes null and then node_row_missing, while an equivalent thrown failure engages the existing ReplicaDispatchService recovery-eligible sync fallback. Preserve red-on-revert evidence.

A successful authoritative primary-key read with zero rows remains definitive absence and may produce node_row_missing. A failed, timed-out, backpressured, participant-failed, or otherwise unavailable authoritative read must preserve its typed failure and retry metadata; it must not become a row, null, successful empty, or permission to dispatch.

Reuse the existing system-metadata owner, control-plane gateway error metadata, bounded authoritative readiness refresh, synchronous controlPlaneRecoveryEligible snapshot, dispatch fallback, deferred retry queue, priority surplus REMOVE, quorum-concentration hold, and formation barrier. Add no owner, cache, readiness dimension, timer, retry loop, planner wake, formation exception, or alternate harness.

Only an already-satisfied canonical controlPlaneRecoveryEligible synchronous snapshot may allow dispatch after a retryable authoritative refresh failure. Non-priority work, repair-ineligible nodes, successful-empty node reads, non-retryable failures, stale/absent snapshots, and missing local handler capability remain fail-closed or deferred exactly as today.

Prefer the smallest owner-contract correction that preserves failure metadata for authoritative primary-key reads. If a generic SystemMetadataOwnerBase contract change affects other metadata owners, prove their successful-row, successful-empty, cache-read, and failure behavior in the same attempt; otherwise introduce only a typed observation surface on the existing owner and route readiness through it.

Do not redefine priority spread, quorum concentration, target cardinality, voter roles, surplus REMOVE safety, or ready-lease formation policy in this Quest. The observed 4-voter/3-node summary disagreement remains diagnostic context; this Quest changes only unavailable-versus-absent authority propagation into the existing dispatch fallback.

Do not widen the 120-second formation or dispatch budgets, lower workload, weaken node readiness, accept process liveness as ready membership, bypass authoritative refresh generally, change statistical bars, or reinterpret final acknowledgement unverified as data loss.

Use a focused TLA+ model for the temporal choice among sync recovery eligibility, authoritative read success-empty, authoritative read failure, fallback, dispatch, and retry. The failure-collapses-to-absence mutant must expose the liveness counterexample. Keep the existing Alloy gate green without extending Alloy because this selected correction changes authority-state propagation, not membership cardinality or ownership relationships.

After deterministic, adjacent, model, analyzer, and independent exact-candidate verification closure on one clean commit, run at most one changed N=1 rolling-restart diagnostic. Do not spend an N=15 certification window in this child; return any distinct later blocker with exact evidence to the representative parent.
